desc: Run solve_dp vs solve_brute on samples 1–3 and exhaustively on all balanced strings with N ≤ 4; fix B-step weight to (v + d + 1); DP validated.
From the validated DP, look for a closed form / greedy product formula. Result: no single-counter greedy; differential-operator GF formulation found.

Design the fast algorithm: analyzed differential-operator formulation and run-length decomposition — concluded neither yields sub-quadratic solution; v-support genuinely Θ(N); no NTT/reflection trick found.

Re-examine the matching structure for a global closed form: test "product over excursions/runs" hypothesis on targeted families against the validated DP; fit DP values for all strings N≤5 to candidate formulas; investigate whether the cut constraint decomposes the matching recursively (leftmost-white conditioning) yielding O(N) or O(N log N).

If a closed form/recursion is found, implement and validate against O(N²) DP on random strings and edge cases; otherwise optimize the O(N²) DP (array-based, early termination, numpy) for the largest feasible N and finalize.
Stress-test final solution against the O(N²) DP on random strings and edge cases (alternating, all B then all W, S starting with W, N=1), then finalize submission code.
